tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground on every surface: front page, masthead, Blog feed, article pages, Magazine, TV hub, membership cards. Text on it: navy, ink-body, slate, slate-meta, slate-caption, gator-blue, orange-text.

tokens.name: paper-white
tokens.usage: Mobile shell bar, mobile drawer panel and form inputs. Text on it: navy-deep, navy, gator-blue, slate-ui.

tokens.name: stone
tokens.usage: Ground of the voices band and letterbox behind the lead photo. navy (12.8:1), slate-meta (5.2:1) and orange-text (4.8:1) all read on it.

tokens.name: photo-well
tokens.usage: Letterbox behind story, wire, Blog and Magazine photos, which are set with object-fit: contain so no photo is cropped and no box is ever empty.

tokens.name: wash
tokens.usage: Current item in the mobile drawer, behind navy-deep text.

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Primary ink: headlines, front-page text, section nav, the 3px masthead and Magazine cover rules, the Join and plan buttons, the Magazine promo panel. 14.6:1 on paper. The front page root sets a near-match, #10233f; use navy.

tokens.name: navy-deep
tokens.usage: Footer ground; mobile shell and drawer text on paper-white (18.4:1); text on a gator-orange fill (5.2:1).

tokens.name: on-navy
tokens.usage: Text on navy (14.9:1), navy-deep (18.4:1) and gator-blue (11.9:1) fills: button labels, the Magazine panel, footer links.

tokens.name: ink-body
tokens.usage: Article body copy and form labels, on paper or paper-white (12.4:1).

tokens.name: slate
tokens.usage: Decks under the lead headline and story summaries, on paper (7.3:1).

tokens.name: slate-meta
tokens.usage: Bylines, dates and Blog meta, on paper (5.9:1) or stone (5.2:1). The edition line (#5b6573) and Magazine muted text (#5f6b80) are near-matches; use slate-meta.

tokens.name: slate-caption
tokens.usage: Photo captions and credits at 10px, on paper (4.9:1).

tokens.name: slate-ui
tokens.usage: Mobile drawer footer text, on paper-white (5.0:1).

tokens.name: gator-blue
tokens.usage: Links that move the reader on: Read the story, the refresh notice, drawer footer links; the Join button's hover fill; the menu glyph's bars. 11.7:1 on paper.

tokens.name: orange
tokens.usage: The accent rule: the 4px top rule on section titles, lead copy, promo panels and plan cards, the 3px Blog heading underline and the keyboard focus ring (3.8:1 on paper, 3.9:1 on navy). Too light for small text: use orange-text.

tokens.name: gator-orange
tokens.usage: The mobile shell's 4px top border, the current-item marker in the drawer and the mobile Join fill, whose label is navy-deep (5.2:1). Not for text on paper.

tokens.name: orange-text
tokens.usage: Kickers and the current section in the nav, on paper (5.5:1) or stone (4.8:1). The front-page nav uses a near-match, #bc3d0c.

tokens.name: orange-focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring on the front page (4.1:1 on paper); inner pages ring in orange.

tokens.name: peach
tokens.usage: Kickers on navy, as in the Magazine promo panel (8.2:1).

tokens.name: peach-focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring on the mobile shell's menu trigger, close button and drawer. 1.7:1 on paper-white, under the 3:1 a focus ring needs; kept as the source ships it. On navy it holds 8.7:1.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Structural dividers: under the section nav, above the front-page grid, the support row and the lower section, and under the Watch panels.

tokens.name: rule-soft
tokens.usage: Column dividers (the masthead tagline, voices columns) and input borders. 1.6:1 on paper-white, under the 3:1 a control border needs; kept as the source ships it.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: List separators and the left divider of the Latest column.

tokens.name: hairline-cool
tokens.usage: Blog feed item separators, the Blog category bar and recent-post borders.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Magazine hairlines: under the mast, above the cover lines, under inside cards.

tokens.name: plan-line
tokens.usage: Border of a membership plan card (its top edge is a 4px orange rule).

tokens.name: shell-line
tokens.usage: Bottom border of the mobile shell bar and the drawer head.

tokens.name: drawer-line
tokens.usage: Separators between mobile drawer items.

tokens.name: control-line
tokens.usage: Borders of the mobile menu trigger and drawer close button. 1.8:1 on paper-white, under 3:1; kept as the source ships it.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind the open mobile drawer (navy-deep at 56%).

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Barlow 800 with tight tracking for every headline. Phone sizes are in each usage note.

styles.name: tv-title
styles.usage: TV hub page title. 30px on phones.

styles.name: lead-headline
styles.sample: The Swamp Knows Something the Big Ten Doesn’t
styles.usage: The front-page lead, fluid clamp(29px, 2.7vw, 36px). 28px / 1.12 on phones.

styles.name: page-title
styles.sample: Florida After Auburn: 5 Signs Sumrall’s Gators Are Rising
styles.usage: Article titles (line-height 1.16), the Magazine cover lead, the membership and contact page titles, the Blog heading (34px). 28px on phones; article titles 25px / 1.14.

styles.name: panel-headline
styles.usage: Headlines in the front page's right-rail panels: Magazine, Watch & Listen, Game Week Reference.

styles.name: band-headline
styles.usage: The voices band label and the Magazine 'Inside' heading (30px).

styles.name: story-headline
styles.sample: Jon Sumrall Stayed Home. So Did His Star Running Back. It Was A Brilliant Choice.
styles.usage: Support and coverage stories, voices columns, Blog feed titles, Magazine references. 19px on phones; Blog titles 21px.

styles.name: card-headline
styles.usage: Magazine cover lines and inside cards (22px). 19px on phones.

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: Module labels (Latest, More from the newsroom), always under a 4px orange rule.

styles.name: wire-headline
styles.sample: Buster Faulkner's offense is anything but predictable
styles.usage: Headlines in the Latest grid.

styles.name: article-body
styles.sample: So there he was Saturday night, a game-time decision with a bad ankle, stepping into Jordan-Hare Stadium for the first time in his life.
styles.usage: Article paragraphs and list items, 940px measure. 16px / 1.62 on phones.

styles.name: deck
styles.sample: Buddy Martin on Florida–Ole Miss, The Swamp’s home-field edge and the SEC’s chance to challenge the Big Ten’s championship run.
styles.usage: Deck under the lead headline (max 70ch) and the Magazine cover lead. 14px / 1.5 on phones.

styles.name: body-small
styles.sample: The columns, characters and stories worth keeping.
styles.usage: Copy inside promo panels; form labels (line-height 1.4).

styles.name: card-dek
styles.sample: Eddie Gilley breaks down Florida’s 44-39 win at Auburn.
styles.usage: Summaries under Magazine inside cards and references; the masthead tagline.

groups.name: UI
groups.note: Barlow 700 for navigation, labels and actions.

styles.name: plan-price
styles.usage: Membership plan price.

styles.name: drawer-link
styles.usage: Items in the mobile drawer.

styles.name: button-large
styles.usage: Plan and form buttons at full width.

styles.name: nav
styles.usage: Section nav, the Join button and panel links.

styles.name: read-link
styles.usage: The Read link and 'All stories →'.

styles.name: menu-trigger
styles.usage: The mobile menu trigger, uppercase.

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: Kickers above headlines, set uppercase by CSS; orange-text on light grounds, peach on navy.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Byline and date lines.

styles.name: edition
styles.usage: Magazine issue line and the edition strip (0.08em).

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Florida at Auburn · Photo: Chris Spears
styles.usage: Photo captions and credits under a figure.

spacing.note: Values as the source uses them, named by pixel size. Gutters step 28 → 18 → 14 as the viewport narrows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Under a section title; the Read link arrow's hover travel.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Photo to meta in a wire item; the mobile shell's vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section title padding under its rule; Read link text-to-arrow gap; meta block margin.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Gutter at 360px and below; lead copy padding under its rule; deck margin above.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Kicker margin above; row gap on phones; drawer Join margin.

tokens.name: space-18
tokens.usage: Page gutter on phones; lead grid gap on phones; padding above panel links.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Row gap in the Latest grid; drawer item side padding.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Column gap in story rows; padding beside a column divider; plan card and voices padding; Magazine gutter.

tokens.name: space-28
tokens.usage: Page gutter on desktop; Magazine panel padding; voices column gap.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Gap between the main column and the right rail; Magazine cover column gap.

tokens.name: space-36
tokens.usage: Margin around the voices band; bottom of the lower section.

radius.note: Square. Every card, button, input and panel has 0 corners; the source overrides Wix's own rounding to 0.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Everything: buttons, plan cards, panels, photos, inputs, the mobile trigger.

tokens.name: radius-bar
tokens.usage: The three bars of the menu glyph.

tokens.name: radius-circle
tokens.usage: The drawer's close button, the one round control.

shadow.note: Flat. Rules separate things, not shadows; only the mobile shell and its drawer lift.

tokens.name: shadow-shell
tokens.usage: Under the sticky mobile shell on the front page (inner pages set none).

tokens.name: shadow-drawer
tokens.usage: The open mobile drawer's left edge.

border.note: The rule hierarchy: orange 4px starts a module, navy 3px frames the masthead and Magazine, navy 2px frames a band, 1px divides.

tokens.name: border-1
tokens.usage: Dividers and hairlines, card and input borders.

tokens.name: border-2
tokens.usage: Top and bottom of the voices band, in navy.

tokens.name: border-3
tokens.usage: Top of the section nav and the Magazine cover (navy); under the Blog heading (orange); the focus ring width.

tokens.name: border-4
tokens.usage: The accent rule in orange over section titles, lead copy, panels and plan cards; the mobile shell top in gator-orange; the drawer's current-item marker.

tokens.name: measure-page
tokens.usage: Masthead and front page.

tokens.name: measure-magazine
tokens.usage: Magazine page.

tokens.name: measure-article
tokens.usage: Article pages.

tokens.name: measure-form
tokens.usage: Contact form.

tokens.name: measure-deck
tokens.usage: Deck line length.

tokens.name: tap-target
tokens.usage: Minimum height of every link row, button and control.

tokens.name: logo-width
tokens.usage: Wordmark in the masthead; 240px on the Magazine mast, 190px in the mobile shell, 168px in the drawer.

tokens.name: bp-tablet
tokens.usage: Lead story stacks its photo over the copy; right rail narrows to 230px.

tokens.name: bp-phone
tokens.usage: Desktop masthead hides and the mobile shell takes over; every grid drops to one column.

tokens.name: bp-small
tokens.usage: Blog feed goes to one column with 16:9 photos.

tokens.name: bp-compact
tokens.usage: Mobile shell tightens to 60px.

tokens.name: bp-tiny
tokens.usage: Gutter drops to 14px.

tokens.name: ratio-lead
tokens.usage: Lead photo on desktop (max 430px tall); 16 / 11 at 230px tall on phones.

tokens.name: ratio-story
tokens.usage: Support and coverage story photos.

tokens.name: ratio-card
tokens.usage: Latest grid, Blog feed and Magazine inside cards.

tokens.name: ratio-cover
tokens.usage: Magazine cover photo.

tokens.name: ratio-thumb
tokens.usage: Magazine card thumbnails on phones.

tokens.name: ratio-logo
tokens.usage: The wordmark.
